name: relaydeck
description: Two-way tasks between your agent and the Relaydeck app on iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch: the agent reports its work, and it gets your tasks, answers, and messages.

api_key.title: Relaydeck API key
api_key.description: Create a key in the Relaydeck iOS app. The key starts with mck_.

idle_watch_minutes.title: Minutes to listen while the agent waits
idle_watch_minutes.description: After the agent stops, the plugin listens for new inbox items for this many minutes and wakes the agent when one comes. Set 0 to turn this off.
